잠언-5-1.title: 잠언 5장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-1.exegesis: 27. (Compare Pr 4:25 ). Avoid all by-paths of evil ( De 2:27 ; 17:11). A life of integrity requires attention to heart, speech, eyes, and conduct.
잠언-5-1.theologicalNote: 27. (Compare Pr 4:25 ). Avoid all by-paths of evil ( De 2:27 ; 17:11). A life of integrity requires attention to heart, speech, eyes, and conduct.

잠언-5-2.title: 잠언 5장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 5 Pr 5:1-23 . A warning against the seductive arts of wicked women, enforced by considering the advantages of chastity, and the miserable end of the wicked. 1. This connection of wisdom and understanding is frequent ( Pr 2:2 ; 3:7 ); the first denotes the use of wise means for wise ends; the other, the exercise of a proper discrimination in their discovery.

잠언-5-4.title: 잠언 5장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-4.exegesis: 3. (Compare Pr 2:16 ). Her enticing promises are deceitful.
잠언-5-4.theologicalNote: 3. (Compare Pr 2:16 ). Her enticing promises are deceitful.

잠언-5-5.title: 잠언 5장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-5.exegesis: 4. her end-- literally, "her future," in sense of reward, what follows (compare Psa 37:37 ; 73:17 ). Its nature is evinced by the use of figures, opposite those of Pr 5:3 . The physical and moral suffering of the deluded profligate are notoriously terrible.

잠언-5-6.title: 잠언 5장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-6.exegesis: 5. feet ... , steps-- that is, course of life ends in death.
잠언-5-6.theologicalNote: 5. feet ... , steps-- that is, course of life ends in death.

잠언-5-7.title: 잠언 5장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-7.exegesis: 6. her ways ... know-- Some prefer, "that she may not ponder the path of life," &c.; but perhaps a better sense is, "her ways are varied, so as to prevent your knowledge of her true character, and so of true happiness."

잠언-5-11.title: 잠언 5장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-11.exegesis: 10. wealth-- literally, "strength," or the result of it. labours-- the fruit of thy painful exertions ( Psa 127:2 ). There may be a reference to slavery, a commuted punishment for death due the adulterer ( De 22:22 ).

잠언-5-12.title: 잠언 5장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-12.exegesis: 11. at the last-- the end, or reward (compare Pr 5:4 ). mourn-- roar in pain. flesh and ... body-- the whole person under incurable disease.

잠언-5-16.title: 잠언 5장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-5-16.exegesis: 15-20. By figures, in which well, cistern, and fountain [Pr 5:15, 18] represent the wife, and rivers of waters [Pr 5:16] the children, men are exhorted to constancy and satisfaction in lawful conjugal enjoyments. In Pr 5:16 , fountains (in the plural) rather denote the produce or waters of a spring, literally, "what is from a spring," and corresponds with "rivers of waters."
